units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 3a:3">R. Hash. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>סיחון שדומה לס׳ וכ׳</he> he was named Sihon, because he was (quick or untamed) as a foal in the desert. Pesik. Ekha, p. 123ᵃ, v. <cite ref="K01007"><he>כָּפָה</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>סַיָּיחִים</he>, <he>סַיָּיחִין</he>. Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ <he>ס׳ מבפנים ואימותיהן וכ׳</he> foals (sucklings) within and their mothers without; (Bab.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:8:2">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. [read:] <he>שלא יאכיל … סייח לס׳</he> he must not feed … foals with a foal (sell one of the animals in his keeping to feed the others).
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:20">Tosef. B. Mets. II, 20</cite>.
Lev. R. s. 20, a. e. הרבה ס׳ מתו וכ׳ many foals died and their skins were spread on their mothers’ backs (many old men survive the young); a. fr.—Fem. סַיָּיחָה.
